synonyms: The Science Notes of Delta and Gamma
synopsis: Upon enrolling at Tsunaga High School, Shu Ide finds himself, for some reason, tagging along with the popular girl Rio Iwama. The two of them end up at the “Couple’s Cherry Tree,” said to grant wishes for love, and notice something strange about the tree. “Let’s investigate… scientifically!” A modest record of the activities of Tsunaganoi High School’s “Science Club,” where high school students with a deep love for science tackle the many mysteries they encounter in their daily lives — including the mystery of first love. (Source: Kadocomi, translated)

title: Otoko Ippiki Gaki Daishou
synonyms: A Shining Example of Gang Leader
synopsis: This monumental manga became the driving force behind Shonen Jump, the tough kid boss of the neighborhood, Mankichi Togawa, uses his fighting skills and charm to find friends as he takes on the bad guys and the big shots who control Japan's financial world. This series, which was followed enthusiastically by the youth of the time, blazed the trail for a new class of readers. This work embodies the spirit of the magazine Shonen Jump. It had a major influence on the authors who followed. In 1969, it became the first Shonen Jump work to be turned into animation, and in 1971 it was turned into a live action film. (Source: Weekly Shounen Jump Exhibition Vol.1 Catalog)

title: Petals of Reincarnation
titleNative: リィンカーネーションの花弁
synonyms: มหาศึกวีรชนข้ามภพ
synopsis: Striving for talent, Senji Touya tries everything he can so he can find it. Kendou, dancing, swimming, basketball, soccer, chess,... anything he tries, he fails to exceed it. One day, his classmate, Haito, came to school for once in a long time. Senji refers her as someone who "has it" or someone who has talent. Later on, he found out that she isn't just someone who has talent, but someone who "took" the talent of herself in her past life. And, those who "took" the talent from their past lives, are also known as "Returners"…

synonyms: I Want a Divorce, Please Stop Obsessing Over Me!
Don’t Be Obsessed, Let’s Get a Divorce!
synopsis: Edelis Brill, the beloved only daughter of a countess, sees herself stabbed to death by the emperor's sword in a book she discovers in her study. Seeking to change her fate, Edelis rescues the book's sole main character, the slave gladiator Lehan, and pours her endless affection into him. But! Lehan, whom she believed would protect her from the emperor's blade, has returned as the emperor, intent on her heart?! Edelis tries to escape, but Lehan's obsession grows ever stronger... Stop obsessing, divorce me! (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: World End Economica
synopsis: Roughly 16 years after the people who emigrated to the Moon had settled themselves. An age where a great number of people are chasing their wild dreams within the great skyscraper at humanity's frontier. A young boy named Hal, born and raised on the Moon, is one of those people chasing his wildest dream. His dream, is to stand where no man has before. In order to do so, he needed capital. A ludicrous amount of capital. The boy named Hal was facing a place that gathered up people's desires. Sometimes it granted them, and sometimes it crushed them mercilessly. There are only two key rules that govern that land. "The first rule, is to never take a loss. The second rule, is to never forget the first." Only those who followed these rules were able to obtain enormous wealth. The stock market. A place that has gathered crowds of persistent men and women for centuries. (Source: WEE Official)

title: HG ni Koisuru Futari
synonyms: Two Girls in Love with High Grade Model Kits
Two People in Love with HG
synopsis: When she was 14, Sayaka Kanzaki had her first encounter with Gundam, and her fascination for MS was awakened as if by fate. But her family and friends did not understand the hobby, so she had to hide her interest from the world. Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category. - Includes 15 extra chapters.
